zh-Hans: 修复部分任务文件夹可读但运行环境无法启动的问题。改进火山引擎流式语音识别，及时显示修正后的文字和标点，并增加流式识别开关。 简化供应商名称，套餐保留 Agent Plan、Token Plan 等标识。
en-US: Fixed execution access to some readable task folders. Improved live Volcengine speech recognition so revised text and punctuation update while speaking, and added a streaming recognition switch. Simplified provider names while retaining Agent Plan, Token Plan and other plan labels.
